name: Paper2Bench Repro — protected offline verification
description: Inspect the enrolled Paper2Bench revision and run deterministic reproducibility-core checks in the bridge's network-disabled verification sandbox. The companion capsule is unbound until its repository and staged image are selected.

risks: Requires an owner-enrolled Paper2Bench repository and an explicitly staged Python dependency image on the paired Mac.
Do not substitute an unrelated enrolled repository ID.
The verifier exercises trusted synthetic algorithms; it does not execute generated code, call models, or reproduce a published paper.
